name: Stretch & Strengthen
description: Pick the muscles you want to work — on the real body, by tapping them — and get the exercises and stretches that actually cover them. Rank by how much of your pick a move hits, or flip to the most focused move that hits your pick and little else. Every move carries plain-language how-to, what kit it needs, and its targets light up on the body. Educational reference, not medical or personal training advice.
